# spyro apache

Manage Apache web server on remote server.

## Before you run it

Service group for Apache hosts (`status`, `version`, `modules`, `sites`, `restart`). `restart` needs a profile with `sudo = true`.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro apache`

```text
Usage: spyro apache [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage Apache web server on remote server.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  modules  List loaded Apache modules.
  restart  Restart Apache.
  sites    List enabled Apache virtual hosts.
  status   Show Apache server status.
  version  Show Apache version.
```
